items.title: James Moody interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Diego, California, February 13, 1998
items.q: Dizzy and Lorraine’s apartment was like, it was okay, it was furnished.

ctx.x: Was that band, was it a struggle to keep it solvent?

Well I would assume that it probably was. Because one of the — the 2040 Seventh Avenue, that address, I think that was it, and Dizzy and Lorraine’s apartment was like, it was okay, it was furnished. But the guy that worked for Dizzy, the one that he hired, Carpenter, his apartment was great, these plush rugs, and I said, wait a minute — this is the other way around. Anyway like later on they found out. And I said now how stupid can you be, because he lived on the first floor, and — so what’s the matter, we’re not…
Well when you were in Europe, you considered staying you said. You considered staying in Europe. But you didn’t.
